result.topic_en: Calculations in elasticity theory: rewriting a complex expression in polar coordinates, then an energy integral for a cylinder (torsion/extension) with displacements α = m x, u = p x, its evaluation over a circular cross-section of radius R and its variation.
result.transcription:
$\frac{\partial \varrho e^{\psi i}}{2 r\partial r} q + \frac{\partial \varrho e^{\psi i}}{\partial e^{2\varphi i}} \frac{1}{q} - 1$
$= \frac{\partial \varrho e^{\psi i}}{2\partial r} e^{-\varphi i} + \frac{\partial \varrho e^{\psi i}}{2 i\partial \varphi} e^{-\varphi i}$
$+ \frac{\partial \varrho e^{(\psi-\varphi)i}}{2 r i \partial\varphi} + \frac{\varrho e^{(\psi-\varphi)i}}{2r} - 1$
$= \frac{\partial r\varrho e^{(\psi-\varphi)i}}{2r\partial r} + i\frac{\partial r\varrho e^{(\psi-\varphi)i}}{2r^2\partial\varphi} - 1$
$\frac{\partial r\varrho\cos(\psi-\varphi)}{r\partial r} + \frac{\partial r\varrho\sin(\psi-\varphi)}{r^2\partial\varphi} - 2$

$-4[-\ldots-] = \int \Delta d\tau \Big[(a-b)\Big[r^2\Big(\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial x}\Big)^2 + r^2\Big(\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial r}\Big)^2\Big] + 2a\Big[\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\Big)^2 + \Big(2q + r\frac{\partial q}{\partial r}\Big)^2\Big]$
$- 4(a-b)\frac{q r\frac{\partial q r}{\partial r}}{r} + 4b\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\frac{\partial r^2 q}{r\partial r}\Big]$
$\alpha = m x$
$u = p x$
$\frac{\partial\frac{\partial r^2 q}{r\partial r}}{\partial r} = 0$
[-...-]
$\frac{-4\mathfrak{P}}{2\pi R^2 l} = \frac{1}{R^2}\int r\,dr\,[-\ldots-][r^2(a-b)m^2 + 2a(p^2+4q^2) - 4(a-b)q^2 + 4b\,p\,2q]$
$= \frac{1}{4}R^2(a-b)m^2 + a(p^2+4q^2) - 2(a-b)q^2 + 4b\,pq$
$\frac{-4\delta\mathfrak{P}}{2\pi R^2 l} = \frac{1}{2}R^2(a-b)m\,\delta m + 2\delta p(ap+2bq) + 4\delta q((a+b)q+bp)$
